This Thanksgiving season, we’re turning overtime into overjoy!

From November 10–26, 2025, every POPDARTS® shopper has the chance to score 100% cashback if the Chiefs vs. Cowboys game goes into overtime on Thanksgiving weekend.

• Grab any POPDARTS set before November 26 and check out in this session to lock in your chance to win.
  • If the Chiefs-Cowboys matchup heads into overtime, your qualifying purchase could be completely free — we’ll refund you up to $199.99 (excluding taxes and shipping). No purchase necessary. Open to U.S. residents, 18+. Offer ends Nov 26, 2025.
  • It’s our way of saying thanks for playing, cheering, and keeping the fun going. Because whether you’re throwing darts or tossing the pigskin, we’re all in it for the win.

PLAYABLY’S WINBACK PROMOTION – POPDARTS® “OVERTIME CASHBACK”

NO PURCHASE NECESSARY TO ENTER OR WIN. A PURCHASE

WILL NOT INCREASE YOUR CHANCES OF WINNING.

VOID WHERE PROHIBITED BY LAW.

THIS PROMOTION IS NOT SPONSORED, ENDORSED, OR AFFILIATED WITH THE NATIONAL FOOTBALL LEAGUE, KANSAS CITY CHIEFS, OR DALLAS COWBOYS.

OFFERED ONLY TO LEGAL RESIDENTS OF THE UNITED STATES,

AGE 18 OR OLDER.

If the Kansas City Chiefs vs. Dallas Cowboys professional football game played during Thanksgiving weekend 2025 (the “Game”) goes into overtime, all customers who purchase an eligible product during the Promotion Period will receive a full refund of their qualifying purchase!

This Thanksgiving season, we’re turning overtime into overjoy! From November 10–26, 2025, every POPDARTS® shopper has the chance to score 100% cashback if the Chiefs vs. Cowboys game goes into overtime on Thanksgiving weekend. See the official promotion terms below for details:

1. PROMOTION PERIOD

Baotris, Inc. DBA PlayAbly (“Sponsor”) is offering the “WinBack” Promotion (“Promotion”) beginning at 12:00:00 AM PST on November 10, 2025, and ending at 11:59:59 PM PST on November 26, 2025 (the “Promotion Period”).

2. PROMOTION ELIGIBILITY

Promotion is open only to legal residents of the United States who are 18 years of age or older as of the date of entry. The following persons are not eligible to participate in the Promotion: Sponsor; any of Sponsor’s parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, or advertising and promotion agencies; and any employee, officer, director, representative or agent of any of the foregoing persons and the immediate family members (spouses and siblings, children and parents and their spouses, regardless of where they live) or members of the same households (whether related or not) of such individuals. Void where prohibited or restricted by law. Sponsor may verify eligibility at any time. Sponsor will make any determinations of eligibility. Sponsor’s decision as to eligibility is final.

3. TO PARTICIPATE

Eligible customers can enter the Promotion in the following ways:

Entry Method 1 – Conditional Rebate Promotion

Purchase a POPDARTS® product with a retail value of one hundred dollars ($100) or more (exclusive of taxes, fees, and shipping charges) from POPDARTS (“BRAND”) on https://playably.ai/ during the Promotion Period (each, an “Eligible Product”). Customers who purchase an Eligible Product during the Promotion Period (“Qualifying Purchase”) will receive a full refund if the Game goes into overtime during Thanksgiving weekend 2025 (i.e., if at the end of regulation time the score is tied and an overtime period is required to determine a winner) (the “Conditional Event”).

If the Conditional Event occurs, all customers who made a Qualifying Purchase are entitled to a full refund of the purchase price actually paid for the Eligible Product purchased during the Promotion Period (each, a “Rebate”) by following the Rebate terms in Section 4 below. If the Conditional Event does not occur, no Rebates will be awarded. Limit one (1) Rebate per person/per household for eligible purchases.

Products purchased during the Promotion Period are not eligible for a refund unless the refund is requested prior to the occurrence of the Conditional Event. Any refund requested before the Conditional Event will no longer qualify for a Rebate. Following the occurrence or non-occurrence of the Conditional Event, customers will not be entitled to a refund and may only request an exchange, which shall be granted at the Sponsor’s sole discretion.

Entry Method 2 – Mail-In Entry

Mail a handwritten postcard to:

Baotris, Inc. dba PlayAbly

3242 Lincoln Ave

Honolulu, HI 96816

and include the following information:


  • Full Name

  • Telephone Number

  • Email Address

  • Mailing Address

  • “WinBack” Promotion

  • Chiefs vs. Cowboys Thanksgiving Weekend 2025

If the Conditional Event occurs, one (1) winner will be randomly selected from all eligible mail-in entries to receive one (1) POPDARTS Gift Card of $100 (see Mail-In Entry Prize Details below). If the Conditional Event does not occur, no mail-in entry drawing will be conducted.

No purchase necessary to enter or win. Mail-in entry postcard and/or envelope must be written by the eligible customer only. Eligible customers are not permitted to use any third-party service to assist with the entry process in any way (as determined by the Sponsor). Each postcard or envelope must be mailed individually. Bulk shipment of mail-in entries will not be accepted. Limit one (1) mail-in entry per person/per household.

Limit one (1) entry per person/household total. Customers who make Qualifying Purchases are not eligible for mail-in entry. Mail-in entrants are not eligible for purchase-based Rebates.

Eligible purchases and/or mail-in postcards must be completed, postmarked, and received by Sponsor no later than 11:59:59 PM PST on November 26, 2025. Any attempt by a person to use multiple identities, fraudulent transactions, cancelled transactions, or any kind of bot or automated mechanisms to gain more mail-in entries or Rebates than permitted by these Promotion terms shall result in disqualification in Sponsor’s sole discretion. By participating, eligible customers warrant and represent that they agree to be bound by these terms and the final decisions of the Sponsor. Sponsor reserves the right to disqualify customers suspected of participating in the activities defined above, or any kind of tampering with the Promotion process. Entry information becomes the exclusive property of Sponsor upon submission. Proof of submission of entry does not constitute proof of receipt of entry. It is the sole responsibility of the entrant to notify the Sponsor in writing if the entrant changes his or her telephone number during the Promotion.

4. REBATE TERMS

If the Conditional Event occurs, Sponsor will send an email to the address associated with the Qualifying Purchase containing a link to a Typeform® to collect the information necessary to process the Rebate, including the customer’s Venmo or PayPal account name and number. To claim the Rebate, customers must complete and submit the Typeform® within forty-five (45) days of the email delivery date.

Customers are solely responsible for completing all required forms accurately and providing all information and documentation requested by Sponsor, which may include proof of purchase, proof of identity, age verification, and/or proof of legal residence. Failure to timely or fully submit the required information or documentation will result in forfeiture of the Rebate. Customers are solely responsible for any and all taxes arising from or related to the Rebate and may be required to complete, electronically sign, and submit an IRS Form W-9 or other tax documentation as required by law. Where permitted by law, customers who receive a Rebate grant Sponsor the right to use winner’s name, city/state, likeness, and prize information for advertising and publicity purposes without additional compensation.

Sponsor is not responsible for any errors, omissions, or delays in communication or transmission, including but not limited to incorrect or incomplete email addresses, spam filters, network issues, or other delivery problems beyond Sponsor’s reasonable control. Rebate payments will be processed within thirty (30) days following Sponsor’s receipt and verification of all required materials.

Sponsor may disqualify any customer from the Conditional Rebate program in its sole discretion if: (a) they fail to provide any required information or documents within the required time period; or (b) they fail to comply with any of these Promotion terms.

5. RANDOM DRAWING / ODDS FOR MAIL-IN ENTRIES

Within seven (7) days of the Conditional Event, Sponsor will select one (1) mail-in entry winner by way of a random number generator from among all eligible entries received. Odds of winning the mail-in prize depend on the number of eligible entries received and the occurrence of the Conditional Event.

6. MAIL-IN ENTRY PRIZE

If the Conditional Event occurs, one (1) mail-in winner will receive one (1) POPDARTS Gift Card valued at one hundred dollars (US $100) (the “Prize”). The Prize will be procured, administered, and distributed by Sponsor in the following manner: if the Conditional Event occurs, the gift card will be provided via email and usable only at BRAND (POPDARTS). Gift card terms apply; not redeemable for cash except as required by law. The winner will not receive cash value or any other form of compensation. No Prize transfer. No other Prize substitution, except at Sponsor’s sole discretion due to unavailability, in which case a prize of comparable or greater value will be awarded.

All taxes (including without limitation Federal, state and local taxes) in connection with the Prize, and the reporting consequences thereof, are the sole responsibility of the winner. Prize winner may be required to sign and return an IRS W-9 form within the time period specified by Sponsor, and such winner will receive an IRS Form 1099 issued in his/her name for the actual value of prizes received if required by law. Sponsor has not made nor is in any manner responsible for any warranty, representation, or guarantee relative to the Prize, including but not limited to its quality, mechanical condition, or fitness for a particular purpose. Sponsor is not responsible for any and all activities in connection with participation in the mail-in entry methods and/or acceptance and fulfillment of the Prize, including but not limited to, any medical illness, personal injury, misuse injury, losses, exposure to COVID-19, or damages in connection with the Prize or potential winner’s usage of the Prize following delivery.

7. WINNER NOTIFICATION / VERIFICATION / ADDITIONAL PRIZE RESTRICTIONS

The potential mail-in entry winner will be notified by email within ten (10) days of the Conditional Event, to verify his/her eligibility and ability to accept the Prize. If such a potential winner is not available or if there is no answer at the time any email is sent, a phone call will be made and a voice message will be left, if possible. Any such email, phone call, or voice message will instruct the potential winner to call a specified telephone number or reply by email within seven (7) days (measured in the local time zone) after the time that the notification message was left.

Potential winner may be required to complete, electronically sign, and submit an Affidavit of Eligibility and IRS Form W-9 (if required by law) within seven (7) days of the date notice or attempted notice is sent, in order to claim his/her Prize. Potential winner may also be required to reply as instructed to identify him/herself, confirm his/her eligibility and ability to accept the Prize, and provide his/her complete contact information within such time period, or he/she will be disqualified. In Sponsor’s sole discretion, a potential winner may only be notified one time as set forth above for attempted prize notification.

If the potential winner does not respond within the seven (7) day time period, Sponsor reserves the right to award the Prize to another potential winner by way of another random drawing. The winner agrees that by accepting the Prize, the Sponsor reserves the right to use the winner’s likeness for marketing purposes without further compensation. Proof of identity, age, and legal residence may be required to claim the Prize.

Any winner or potential winner may be disqualified in Sponsor’s sole discretion if: (a) he/she fails to provide any required information or properly completed documents within the required time period; (b) he/she fails to comply with any of the terms of these Official Rules; or (c) if any Prize or prize notification is returned as undeliverable, any voicemail or email message is not timely returned, or any forms sent to potential winner are not timely returned as instructed. In the event of disqualification of a winner or potential winner, at Sponsor’s sole discretion the Prize may be awarded to an alternate winner (or runner up) selected from among the remaining applicable eligible entries via the means of winner determination described herein, pending verification of eligibility.

All prizes will be awarded. No responsibility is assumed by Sponsor for any incorrect or missing postal address, email address or phone number associated with an entry, or any change of address, email or phone number of entrants after entry submission. Sponsor will hold all winning entries for at least sixty (60) days following the completion of the Promotion. Where permitted by law, winner grants Sponsor the right to use winner’s name, city/state, likeness, and prize information for advertising and publicity purposes without additional compensation.

For a copy of the Official Rules or Winners List, send a self-addressed, stamped envelope and a hand-written request for the applicable sweepstakes promotion (identifying Sponsor and sweepstakes promotion period) to: BNWL Promotion, Free to Enter c/o Landonis Enterprises, 3242 Lincoln Ave, Honolulu, HI 96816.

8. WARRANTIES AND REPRESENTATIONS

By participating, eligible customers and mail-in entrants warrant and represent that they agree to be bound by these Promotion terms and the final decisions of the Sponsor. Eligible customers further grant Sponsor and its affiliates and sublicensees the right to use the name, city/state, likeness, and prize information for advertising and publicity purposes without additional compensation.

By entering and participating, customers agree to: [a] abide by these Promotion terms and by the decisions of Sponsor, whose decisions are final and binding on all matters pertaining to this Promotion; [b] the use of their names, photographs, testimonials or other likeness and/or personal exposition (and/or any edited portion thereof) by Sponsor and its designee(s) for promotional, advertising and/or publicity purposes in any media, now or hereafter known throughout the universe in perpetuity, including but not limited to the posting of their names on the Promotion Page, without compensation or notice to, or further consent of, the customer to the extent permitted by law; and [c] to release, discharge and hold harmless the Releasees from any and all injuries, liability, losses and damages of any kind resulting from their participation in the Promotion or their acceptance of the Rebate or Prize. Failure to comply with the Promotion terms may result in disqualification at Sponsor’s sole discretion.
